datasets.name: data_freshness
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Ultimo Snapshot Predittivo' AS metric,
  date_format(eo.latest_prediction_feed_datetime, 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm') AS value
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.executive_overview eo
    CROSS JOIN rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata arm
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Ultimo Aggiornamento Gold' AS metric,
  date_format(arm.refresh_timestamp, 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm') AS value
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.executive_overview eo
    CROSS JOIN rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata arm
UNION ALL

  'Elaborazione Predizioni' AS metric,

FROM
  rome_transport.gold.executive_overview eo
    CROSS JOIN rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata arm
UNION ALL

    ELSE arm.quality_status

FROM
  rome_transport.gold.executive_overview eo
    CROSS JOIN rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata arm
UNION ALL
SELECT

    ELSE arm.registration_status
  END AS value
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.executive_overview eo
    CROSS JOIN rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata arm

datasets.name: stop_reliability
queryLines:
SELECT
  stop_id AS `Stop`,
  stop_name,
  observation_count,
  distinct_routes,
  distinct_trips,
  service_date_count,
  mean_delay_seconds,
  median_delay_seconds,
  p90_delay_seconds,
  p95_delay_seconds AS `P95 Delay`,
  p99_delay_seconds,
  major_delay_count,
  major_delay_rate AS `Major Delay Rate`,
  early_rate,
  on_time_rate,
  moderate_delay_rate,
  major_delay_rate_rank_desc,
  p95_delay_rank_desc
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.stop_reliability
WHERE
  observation_count >= 500

datasets.name: temporal_reliability
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.service_date,
  t.day_of_week,
  t.feed_hour AS `Hour`,
  t.time_band AS `Time Band`,
  t.is_weekend AS `Day Type`,
  CASE t.is_weekend
    WHEN 'Weekend' THEN 'Fine Settimana'
    WHEN 'Weekday' THEN 'Giorno Feriale'
    ELSE t.is_weekend
  END AS `Tipo di Giorno`,
  CASE t.time_band
    WHEN 'Night' THEN 'Notte'
    WHEN 'Morning Peak' THEN 'Picco Mattutino'
    WHEN 'Midday' THEN 'Fascia Centrale'
    WHEN 'Evening Peak' THEN 'Picco Serale'
    WHEN 'Evening' THEN 'Sera'
    ELSE t.time_band
  END AS `Fascia Oraria`,
  t.observation_count,
  t.mean_delay_seconds,
  t.median_delay_seconds,
  t.p90_delay_seconds,
  t.p95_delay_seconds,
  t.major_delay_count,
  t.major_delay_rate,
  t.early_rate,
  t.on_time_rate,
  t.moderate_delay_rate,
  SUM(t.major_delay_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.time_band)
    * 1.0
    / SUM(t.observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.time_band) AS `Major Delay Rate`,
  SUM(t.major_delay_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.is_weekend)
    * 1.0
    / SUM(t.observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.is_weekend) AS `Weekend Major Delay Rate`,
  SUM(t.major_delay_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.feed_hour)
    * 1.0
    / SUM(t.observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.feed_hour) AS `Hourly Major Delay Rate`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      service_date,
      day_of_week,
      feed_hour,
      CASE time_band
        WHEN 'night' THEN 'Night'
        WHEN 'morning_peak' THEN 'Morning Peak'
        WHEN 'midday' THEN 'Midday'
        WHEN 'evening_peak' THEN 'Evening Peak'
        WHEN 'evening' THEN 'Evening'
      END AS time_band,
      CASE is_weekend
        WHEN true THEN 'Weekend'
        WHEN false THEN 'Weekday'
      END AS is_weekend,
      observation_count,
      mean_delay_seconds,
      median_delay_seconds,
      p90_delay_seconds,
      p95_delay_seconds,
      major_delay_count,
      major_delay_rate,
      early_rate,
      on_time_rate,
      moderate_delay_rate
    FROM
      rome_transport.gold.temporal_reliability
  ) t

datasets.name: route_reliability
queryLines:
SELECT
  route_id AS `Route`,
  route_short_name,
  observation_count,
  trip_count,
  stop_count,
  service_date_count,
  mean_delay_seconds AS `Mean Delay`,
  median_delay_seconds,

datasets.name: network_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Linea con Tasso di Ritardi Gravi Più Alto' AS metric,
  route_id AS identifier,
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(major_delay_rate * 100, 1) AS STRING), '%') AS value
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.route_reliability
WHERE
  major_delay_rate_rank_desc = 1
  AND observation_count >= 1000
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Linea con Ritardo Medio Più Alto',
  route_id,
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(mean_delay_seconds, 1) AS STRING), ' s')
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.route_reliability
WHERE
  mean_delay_rank_desc = 1
  AND observation_count >= 1000
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Fermata con Tasso di Ritardi Gravi Più Alto',
  stop_id,
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(major_delay_rate * 100, 1) AS STRING), '%')
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.stop_reliability
WHERE
  major_delay_rate_rank_desc = 1
  AND observation_count >= 500
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Fermata con Ritardo P95 Più Alto',
  s.stop_id,
  CONCAT(CAST(s.p95_delay_seconds AS STRING), ' s')
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      stop_id,
      p95_delay_seconds
    FROM
      rome_transport.gold.stop_reliability
    WHERE
      p95_delay_rank_desc = 1
      AND observation_count >= 500
    ORDER BY
      stop_id
    LIMIT 1
  ) s
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Ora Peggiore',
  CONCAT(CAST(h.feed_hour AS STRING), ':00'),
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(h.rate * 100, 1) AS STRING), '% tasso di ritardi gravi')
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      feed_hour,
      SUM(major_delay_count) * 1.0 / SUM(observation_count) AS rate
    FROM
      rome_transport.gold.temporal_reliability
    GROUP BY
      feed_hour
    ORDER BY
      rate DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) h
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Tasso di Ritardi Gravi nel Fine Settimana',
  '—',
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(w.rate * 100, 1) AS STRING), '%')
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(major_delay_count) * 1.0 / SUM(observation_count) AS rate
    FROM
      rome_transport.gold.temporal_reliability
    WHERE
      is_weekend = true
  ) w

datasets.name: delay_propagation
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE current_delay_band
    WHEN 'early' THEN 'Early'
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'On Time'
    WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Moderate Delay'
    WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Major Delay'
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE current_delay_band
  END AS `Current State`,
  CASE current_delay_band
    WHEN 'early' THEN 'In Anticipo'
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'Regolare'
    WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Moderato'
    WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Grave'
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Sconosciuto'
    ELSE current_delay_band
  END AS `Stato Attuale`,
  CASE previous_delay_band
    WHEN 'early' THEN 'Early'
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'On Time'
    WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Moderate Delay'
    WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Major Delay'
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE previous_delay_band
  END AS `Previous State`,
  CASE previous_delay_band
    WHEN 'early' THEN 'In Anticipo'
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'Regolare'
    WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Moderato'
    WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Grave'
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Sconosciuto'
    ELSE previous_delay_band
  END AS `Stato Precedente`,
  observation_count,
  mean_current_delay_seconds,
  mean_previous_stop_delay_seconds,
  mean_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
  median_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
  p90_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
  major_delay_rate AS `Next-Stop Major Delay Risk`,
  mean_delay_change_from_previous_stop AS `Delay Change`,
  median_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds / 60.0 AS median_delay_minutes,
  CONCAT(
    CASE previous_delay_band
      WHEN 'early' THEN 'In Anticipo'
      WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'Regolare'
      WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Moderato'
      WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Grave'
      WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Sconosciuto'
      ELSE previous_delay_band
    END,
    ' → ',
    CASE current_delay_band
      WHEN 'early' THEN 'In Anticipo'
      WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'Regolare'
      WHEN 'moderate_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Moderato'
      WHEN 'major_delay' THEN 'Ritardo Grave'
      WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Sconosciuto'
      ELSE current_delay_band
    END
  ) AS `Transition`,
  weighted_rate_by_current AS `Major Delay Rate`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      current_delay_band,
      previous_delay_band,
      observation_count,
      mean_current_delay_seconds,
      mean_previous_stop_delay_seconds,
      mean_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
      median_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
      p90_realized_next_stop_delay_seconds,
      major_delay_rate,
      mean_delay_change_from_previous_stop,
      SUM(major_delay_rate * observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY current_delay_band)
        * 1.0
        / SUM(observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY current_delay_band) AS weighted_rate_by_current
    FROM
      rome_transport.gold.delay_propagation
  ) t

datasets.name: predictive_ops_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(1) AS observations_scored,
  SUM(predicted_major_delay_flag) AS predicted_major_delays,
  SUM(predicted_major_delay_flag) * 1.0 / COUNT(1) AS predicted_major_delay_rate,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS critical_risk_count,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
    * 1.0
    / COUNT(1) AS critical_risk_share
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations

datasets.name: predictive_ops_trips
queryLines:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    route_short_name,
    trip_id,
    vehicle_id,
    major_delay_probability,
    predicted_major_delay_flag,
    current_arrival_delay_seconds,
    active_alert_flag,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY trip_id ORDER BY major_delay_probability DESC) AS rn
  FROM
    rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
  WHERE
    feed_timestamp
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(feed_timestamp)
        FROM
          rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
      )
)
SELECT
  route_id,
  COALESCE(route_short_name, route_id) AS route_display,
  trip_id,
  vehicle_id,
  major_delay_probability AS highest_risk_probability,
  CASE
    WHEN predicted_major_delay_flag = 1 THEN 'Sì'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS predicted_major_delay,
  current_arrival_delay_seconds,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Sì'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS active_alert
FROM
  ranked
WHERE
  rn = 1
ORDER BY
  major_delay_probability DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: predictive_ops
queryLines:
SELECT
  feed_timestamp,
  feed_datetime,
  service_date,
  route_id,
  route_short_name,
  trip_id,
  vehicle_id,
  stop_id,
  stop_name,
  stop_sequence,
  current_arrival_delay_seconds AS `Current Delay`,
  predicted_next_stop_delay_seconds,
  major_delay_probability AS `Predicted Risk`,
  predicted_major_delay_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN predicted_major_delay_flag = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS predicted_major_delay,
  classification_threshold,
  risk_band,
  CASE
    WHEN risk_band = 'low_risk' THEN 'Low Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'medium_risk' THEN 'Medium Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'high_risk' THEN 'High Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 'Critical Risk'
    ELSE risk_band
  END AS `Risk Band`,
  active_alert_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Active Alert'
    ELSE 'No Active Alert'
  END AS alert_status,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS active_alert,
  vehicle_position_available_flag,
  current_status,
  probability_rank_within_snapshot,
  route_probability_rank_within_snapshot,
  ABS(HASH(trip_id, CAST(stop_sequence AS STRING))) % 10 AS sample_bucket
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
  AND risk_band IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: predictive_ops_priority
queryLines:
SELECT
  route_id,
  COALESCE(route_short_name, route_id) AS route_display,
  trip_id,
  vehicle_id,
  stop_id,
  COALESCE(stop_name, stop_id) AS stop_display,
  current_arrival_delay_seconds,
  predicted_next_stop_delay_seconds,
  major_delay_probability,
  CASE
    WHEN risk_band = 'low_risk' THEN 'Rischio Basso'
    WHEN risk_band = 'medium_risk' THEN 'Rischio Medio'
    WHEN risk_band = 'high_risk' THEN 'Rischio Alto'
    WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 'Rischio Critico'
    ELSE risk_band
  END AS risk_band_label,
  CASE
    WHEN predicted_major_delay_flag = 1 THEN 'Sì'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS predicted_major_delay,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Sì'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS active_alert
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
ORDER BY
  major_delay_probability DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: predictive_ops_routes
queryLines:
SELECT
  route_id,
  COALESCE(route_short_name, route_id) AS `Route`,
  AVG(major_delay_probability) AS `Average Predicted Risk`,
  COUNT(1) AS obs_count
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
GROUP BY
  route_id,
  route_short_name
HAVING
  COUNT(1) >= 10
ORDER BY
  AVG(major_delay_probability) DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: predictive_ops_stops
queryLines:
SELECT
  stop_id,
  COALESCE(stop_name, stop_id) AS `Stop`,
  MAX(major_delay_probability) AS `Maximum Predicted Risk`,
  COUNT(1) AS obs_count
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
  AND stop_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  stop_id,
  stop_name
ORDER BY
  MAX(major_delay_probability) DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: predictive_ops_risk_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN risk_band = 'low_risk' THEN 'Low Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'medium_risk' THEN 'Medium Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'high_risk' THEN 'High Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 'Critical Risk'
    ELSE risk_band
  END AS `Risk Band`,
  COUNT(1) AS `Observation Count`,
  COUNT(1) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER () AS `Share of Observations`
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN risk_band = 'low_risk' THEN 'Low Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'medium_risk' THEN 'Medium Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'high_risk' THEN 'High Risk'
    WHEN risk_band = 'critical_risk' THEN 'Critical Risk'
    ELSE risk_band
  END

datasets.name: predictive_ops_alert
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Active Alert'
    ELSE 'No Active Alert'
  END AS `Alert Status`,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Allerta Attiva'
    ELSE 'Nessuna Allerta'
  END AS `Stato di Allerta`,
  AVG(major_delay_probability) AS `Average Predicted Risk`,
  COUNT(1) AS obs_count
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
WHERE
  feed_timestamp
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(feed_timestamp)
      FROM
        rome_transport.gold.predictive_operations
    )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Active Alert'
    ELSE 'No Active Alert'
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN active_alert_flag = 1 THEN 'Allerta Attiva'
    ELSE 'Nessuna Allerta'
  END

datasets.name: model_perf_reg
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'R2' THEN CONCAT('R', chr(178))
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'MAE' THEN 'MAE'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'RMSE' THEN 'RMSE'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'WAPE' THEN 'WAPE'
    ELSE metric_name
  END AS metric_display,
  CASE
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'R2' THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(metric_value, 3) AS STRING))
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'WAPE' THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(metric_value * 100, 1) AS STRING), '%')
    ELSE CONCAT(CAST(CAST(ROUND(metric_value, 0) AS INT) AS STRING), ' s')
  END AS formatted_value
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance
WHERE
  task = 'regression'
  AND dataset = 'test'
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'MAE' THEN 1
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'RMSE' THEN 2
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'R2' THEN 3
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'WAPE' THEN 4
  END

datasets.name: model_deployment
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    'Configurato' AS scoring_status,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(quality_status) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 'Superato'
      ELSE quality_status
    END AS quality_label,
    CASE
      WHEN
        lower(dashboard_ready) LIKE '%true%'
        OR lower(dashboard_ready) LIKE '%ready%'
        OR lower(dashboard_ready) LIKE '%yes%'
      THEN
        'Pronto'
      ELSE dashboard_ready
    END AS dashboard_label,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(registration_status) LIKE '%defer%' THEN 'Differito'
      ELSE registration_status
    END AS registry_label,
    classification_threshold,
    refresh_timestamp
  FROM
    rome_transport.gold.analytics_refresh_metadata
  ORDER BY
    refresh_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  'Scoring' AS status_item,
  scoring_status AS status_value,
  'Pipeline di elaborazione predittiva configurata per l''ultimo aggiornamento disponibile.' AS status_note
FROM
  latest
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Qualità',
  quality_label,
  CASE
    WHEN
      quality_label = 'Superato'
    THEN
      'Controlli di qualità superati per l''aggiornamento corrente.'
    ELSE 'Stato dei controlli di qualità.'
  END
FROM
  latest
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Dashboard',
  dashboard_label,
  CASE
    WHEN dashboard_label = 'Pronto' THEN 'Dataset della dashboard aggiornati.'
    ELSE 'Stato dei dataset della dashboard.'
  END
FROM
  latest
UNION ALL

datasets.name: model_perf_class
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'ROC_AUC' THEN 'ROC-AUC'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'PR_AUC' THEN 'PR-AUC'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'ACCURACY' THEN 'Accuratezza'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'PRECISION' THEN 'Precisione'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'RECALL' THEN 'Richiamo'
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'F1' THEN 'F1'
    ELSE INITCAP(metric_name)
  END AS `Metric`,
  metric_value AS `Score`
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance
WHERE
  task = 'classification'
  AND dataset = 'test'
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'ACCURACY' THEN 1
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'PRECISION' THEN 2
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'RECALL' THEN 3
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'F1' THEN 4
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'ROC_AUC' THEN 5
    WHEN upper(metric_name) = 'PR_AUC' THEN 6
  END

datasets.name: model_perf_val_vs_test
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE metric_name
    WHEN 'ROC_AUC' THEN 'ROC-AUC'
    WHEN 'PR_AUC' THEN 'PR-AUC'
    ELSE metric_name
  END AS `Metric`,
  CASE dataset
    WHEN 'validation' THEN 'Validation'
    WHEN 'test' THEN 'Test'
    ELSE dataset
  END AS `Dataset`,
  metric_value AS `Score`
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance
WHERE
  task = 'classification'
  AND dataset IN ('validation', 'test')
  AND metric_name IN ('F1', 'ROC_AUC', 'PR_AUC')
ORDER BY
  CASE metric_name
    WHEN 'F1' THEN 1
    WHEN 'ROC_AUC' THEN 2
    WHEN 'PR_AUC' THEN 3
  END,
  CASE dataset
    WHEN 'validation' THEN 1
    WHEN 'test' THEN 2
  END

datasets.name: model_perf_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        task = 'classification'
        AND dataset = 'test'
        AND metric_name = 'F1'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS f1_test,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        task = 'classification'
        AND dataset = 'test'
        AND metric_name = 'ROC_AUC'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS roc_auc_test,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        task = 'classification'
        AND dataset = 'test'
        AND metric_name = 'PR_AUC'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS pr_auc_test,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        task = 'regression'
        AND dataset = 'test'
        AND metric_name = 'MAE'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS mae_test
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance

datasets.name: model_perf_threshold
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(threshold) AS threshold_value,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        dataset = 'validation'
        AND metric_name = 'F1'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS f1_optimized,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        dataset = 'test'
        AND metric_name = 'F1'
      THEN
        metric_value
    END
  ) AS f1_test
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance

datasets.name: model_perf_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Regressione' AS task_label,
  COALESCE(MAX(model_name), 'Persistence') AS solution,
  'MAE' AS primary_metric,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(
      CAST(
        ROUND(
          MAX(
            CASE
              WHEN metric_name = 'MAE' THEN metric_value
            END
          ),
          0
        ) AS INT
      ) AS STRING
    ),
    ' s'
  ) AS test_result,
  'Miglior MAE di validazione' AS notes
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance
WHERE
  task = 'regression'
  AND dataset = 'test'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Classificazione' AS task_label,
  'Random Forest' AS solution,
  'F1' AS primary_metric,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(
      ROUND(
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN metric_name = 'F1' THEN metric_value
          END
        )
          * 100,
        1
      ) AS STRING
    ),
    '%'
  ) AS test_result,
  CONCAT('Soglia = ', CAST(CAST(ROUND(MAX(threshold) * 100, 0) AS INT) AS STRING), '%') AS notes
FROM
  rome_transport.gold.model_performance
WHERE
  task = 'classification'
  AND dataset = 'test'

datasets.name: temporal_reliability_summary
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  `Fascia Oraria`,
  `Major Delay Rate`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      t.service_date,
      t.time_band AS `Time Band`,
      CASE t.time_band
        WHEN 'Night' THEN 'Notte'
        WHEN 'Morning Peak' THEN 'Picco Mattutino'
        WHEN 'Midday' THEN 'Fascia Centrale'
        WHEN 'Evening Peak' THEN 'Picco Serale'
        WHEN 'Evening' THEN 'Sera'
        ELSE t.time_band
      END AS `Fascia Oraria`,
      SUM(t.major_delay_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.time_band)
        * 1.0
        / SUM(t.observation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.time_band) AS `Major Delay Rate`
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          service_date,
          CASE time_band
            WHEN 'night' THEN 'Night'
            WHEN 'morning_peak' THEN 'Morning Peak'
            WHEN 'midday' THEN 'Midday'
            WHEN 'evening_peak' THEN 'Evening Peak'
            WHEN 'evening' THEN 'Evening'
          END AS time_band,
          observation_count,
          major_delay_count
        FROM
          rome_transport.gold.temporal_reliability
      ) t
  ) subquery
WHERE
  `Fascia Oraria` IN ('Notte', 'Picco Mattutino', 'Fascia Centrale', 'Picco Serale', 'Sera')
ORDER BY
  CASE `Fascia Oraria`
    WHEN 'Notte' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Picco Mattutino' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Fascia Centrale' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Picco Serale' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Sera' THEN 5
  END

I ritardi gravi sono altamente persistenti. La variazione media del ritardo è vicina allo zero, indicando che i ritardi gravi tendono a persistere piuttosto che recuperare rapidamente.

### Fasce di Rischio

Le fasce di rischio rappresentano la probabilità prevista di ritardo grave alla fermata successiva:

**Rischio Basso:** Probabilità ≤ 30%  
**Rischio Medio:** Probabilità > 30% e ≤ 50%  
**Rischio Alto:** Probabilità > 50% e ≤ 70%  
**Rischio Critico:** Probabilità > 70%
